# AIOConvert

> AIOConvert is an advanced, privacy-first free online file converter suite.

## About
AIOConvert.com allows users to convert images, videos, documents, and archives securely online. All processing is fast, and files are automatically deleted after 30 minutes.

## Core Features
- **Zero Registration**: 100% free with no signups.
- **Privacy Focus**: Uploaded files are deleted in 30 mins.
- **Fast Conversion**: Lightning-fast servers process files quickly.
- **Format Support**:
  - Image: JPG to PNG, PNG to WebP, HEIF to JPG, etc.
  - Video: MP4 to MP3, MKV to MP4, MOV to MP4, etc.
  - Document: PDF to DOCX, DOCX to PDF, etc.
  - Archive: ZIP to RAR, RAR to ZIP, etc.

## Technical Details
This application is built by ViteNest / ViteRank.
